label: For "Static Analysis False Positive Reduction": Reduce noise from static analysis by ranking findings by the likelihood that engineers will confirm them, using code context and past triage decisions, while keeping all findings available. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Hiding alerts silently.
